decisive_items: cortical destruction of the inner and outer tables
response.rationale: Giant cell tumor is the only candidate matching the lytic, soap-bubble, destructive, and enhancing features; fibrous dysplasia lacks the soap-bubble and enhancement, while osteoma is typically sclerotic, not lytic.

rejected.why: Lacks soap-bubble appearance and avid enhancement; ground-glass pattern not described.
Osteoma is a sclerotic lesion, contradicted by the lytic and destructive findings.
